name: ui-document-panel
description: DocumentPanel — a record rendered as one continuous document: editable title over the rich-text body, editing controls tucked into the header corner. — UI factory (1:1 with the @almadar/ui document-panel pattern).

schema.description: DocumentPanel — a record rendered as one continuous document: editable title over the rich-text body, editing controls tucked into the header corner. — UI factory (1:1 with the @almadar/ui document-panel pattern).
schema.name: ui-document-panel

actions.description: Header actions (settings, history, …). At most one explicit primary stays inline; the rest live under a single '⋯' menu — the title owns its row.
actions.label: Actions

ariaBusy.description: This region is updating; assistive technology waits before announcing it.
ariaBusy.label: Aria-busy

ariaCurrent.description: Marks the current item in a set: the current page, step, location, date or time.
ariaCurrent.label: Aria-current

ariaDescribedby.description: Id of the element whose text describes this one (help text, error).
ariaDescribedby.label: Aria-describedby

ariaExpanded.description: Whether the element it controls is expanded.
ariaExpanded.label: Aria-expanded

ariaHidden.description: Hide from assistive technology (decorative content only).
ariaHidden.label: Aria-hidden

ariaLabel.description: Accessible name read by screen readers when the visible text is missing or not descriptive (e.g. an icon-only control).
ariaLabel.label: Aria-label

ariaLabelledby.description: Id of the element whose text names this one.
ariaLabelledby.label: Aria-labelledby

ariaLive.description: Announce changes to this region: polite waits for a pause, assertive interrupts.
ariaLive.label: Aria-live

ariaSelected.description: Whether this item is selected (tabs, options, grid cells).
ariaSelected.label: Aria-selected

autosaveHint.description: Muted caption beside Done telling the author work persists on its own
autosaveHint.label: Autosave Hint

contentChangeEvent.description: Forwarded to the embedded RichTextEditor's autosave stream: { value }
contentChangeEvent.label: Content Change Event

coverImage.description: Cover/hero image URL painted as a full-bleed banner above the header row (Notion/article-hero shape); hidden when empty
coverImage.label: Cover Image

dir.description: Text direction of this element's content.
dir.label: Dir

doneEvent.description: Emitted by the Done button that ends the editing session: { id }
doneEvent.label: Done Event

editEvent.description: Emitted by the header Edit affordance and a click on the read body: { id }
editEvent.label: Edit Event

editing.description: false = read surface with click-to-edit body; true = live editor
editing.label: Editing

enter.description: How this element animates in when it mounts (theme-styled); overrides the theme's default slot entry. `none` opts out.
enter.label: Enter

enterDelay.description: Stagger step for the entry: waits this many `--motion-enter-stagger` steps before animating.
enterDelay.label: Enter Delay

icon.description: Document icon rendered beside the title (a file glyph, a domain icon); hidden when empty
icon.label: Icon

lang.description: Language of this element's content (BCP 47, e.g. ar, sl, en).
lang.label: Lang

maxInlineActions.description: 0 collapses even the primary action into the menu
maxInlineActions.label: Max Inline Actions

role.description: WAI-ARIA role when the element's native semantics don't describe it.
role.label: Role

subtitle.description: Muted byline under the title; hidden when empty
subtitle.label: Subtitle

tabIndex.description: 0 puts the element in the Tab order; -1 makes it focusable only programmatically.
tabIndex.label: Tab Index

title.description: Document title (falls back to 'Untitled' for a blank draft)
title.label: Title

titleCommitEvent.description: Emitted when the title commits: { title, id }
titleCommitEvent.label: Title Commit Event

value.description: The document body as rich-text HTML
value.label: Value

viewerRole.description: The viewer's role that each action's `roles` is checked against; bind it at the call site (e.g. `viewerRole: @user.role`). Empty = only actions with no `roles` show.
viewerRole.label: Viewer's role

emits.description: Emitted when the title commits: { title, id }
Forwarded to the embedded RichTextEditor's autosave stream: { value }
Emitted by the header Edit affordance and a click on the read body: { id }
Emitted by the Done button that ends the editing session: { id }

events.description: Emitted when the title commits: { title, id }
events.name: @config.title commit event

events.description: Forwarded to the embedded RichTextEditor's autosave stream: { value }
events.name: @config.content change event

events.description: Emitted by the header Edit affordance and a click on the read body: { id }
events.name: @config.edit event

events.description: Emitted by the Done button that ends the editing session: { id }
events.name: @config.done event
